message: 100ｇ五千円

name: Misasagi
message: 「Welcome back」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Misasagi-senpai? What are you doing here... Don't tell me you were waiting for me?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Running into you was just a coincidence, President. I was only planning to drop this in your mailbox and head home」

name: Synn
message: 「A tin of tea leaves?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Say, doesn't Ria sometimes come up to your room for Student Council gatherings, President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, depending on how things are progressing, I hold meetings with everyone here.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「In that case, please accept this」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Even if I'm not a Student Council officer, I can at least bring a small gift, can't I? I want Ria to enjoy some good tea」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Truth be told, as president of the Wagashi Club, I'd love to gift some Kyoto sweets, but they'd be too bulky. Depending on the kind, freshness affects the flavor too...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Besides, knowing Ria, there's no way she wouldn't bring wagashi along as a souvenir」

name: Synn
message: 「Understood. I'll gladly accept it.」
I take the tin of tea leaves wrapped in chiyogami paper. Even though it's unopened, just holding it in my hands envelops me in the faint, pleasant aroma of Japanese tea.

name: Paqy
message: 「What a noble fragrance. This stuff's seriously high-end--」

name: Synn
message: 「D-D-D-Don't say the price!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Quality matters too, President, but with tea, the one who enjoys it most wins, you know? As long as it suits the occasion, even plain hot water is fine」

name: Misasagi
message: 「...Just to be sure, let me ask: do you have the utensils to brew tea?」

name: Synn
message: 「I do have a teapot and a strainer. Still, it seems like I'd be better off learning the tricks to brewing it well from you, Misasagi-senpai.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hmph...」
Misasagi-senpai snaps her folding fan shut with a sharper, heavier sound than usual.
Maybe it's just my imagination, but I fall under the illusion that it has already transcended being a fan and transformed into a dignified pointer stick.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Very well. When it's a request from a boy Ria has taken a liking to, I can hardly refuse. Even if I'm not in the Tea Ceremony Club, I am well-versed in the etiquette of tea」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You don't have to be so stiff about it--」
The closed folding fan slices through the air.

name: Misasagi
message: 「I won't hear a word of taking it back. Now, hurry up and head inside」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Pleased to be in your care」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hmm-hmm. Even though you're entering a room alone with a girl, you aren't the least bit self-conscious in that way, are you? No wonder Ria takes a liking to you」
Misasagi-senpai personally taught me how to brew tea. It wasn't anything Spartan, just thorough and kind instruction.
What I learned wasn't some rigid, etiquette-heavy ceremony, but rather a way to make tea that anyone could enjoy at home.
